description: LFM2-MoE prefill-path depthwise causal conv1d (kernel_size=3, no activation). Input is unpadded; the entry point left-pads by K-1 internally.
name: lfm2_moe_causal_conv1d_prefill
reference:
# Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/5eddc12edfaf8cafde8c9bae4ccb12f8a139b4f9/src/transformers/models/lfm2_moe/modeling_lfm2_moe.py#L385-L405
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, weight, bias=None, activation=None, seq_idx=None):
    # LFM2 short-conv fuses no activation and does not use packed sequences,
    # so `activation` and `seq_idx` are always None at the call site.
    _, hidden_size, seq_len = x.shape
    padding = weight.shape[-1] - 1
    out = F.conv1d(
        x.to(weight.dtype),
        weight=weight.unsqueeze(1),
        bias=bias,
        padding=padding,
        groups=hidden_size,
    )[:, :, :seq_len]
    return out.to(x.dtype)
